critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js sidebar overlay implementation (lines 542-555) is correct: backdrop z-30 + aside z-40 + md:hidden on backdrop + md:relative on aside. Default isSidebarOpen via matchMedia(max-width:767px) is sound. width-anim 0→280 is OK because position is fixed on mobile.
LanguageContext.js is now >1300 lines — split per-language file recommended for maintainability and to avoid this kind of missing-key drift across locales.
auth-email-input readonly-on-mount is causing slow E2E logins. Should track device-key readiness via a state flag rather than DOM-level readonly that blocks both bots and users typing fast.

rca of the issue: FR i18n keys 'dashboard' and 'back_to_menu' were updated in EN (lines 671-672) but the patch never reached the FR block (lines 81-83). Root cause: language objects are duplicated literals in one big file (>1300 lines) so cross-locale parity is easy to miss.
